recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If OO later wants smoother NutritionIntake sentence phrasing, handle that as general editorial cleanup; FHIR-52017 itself is already applied in build-scope source.
issue_request: FHIR-52017 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for R6 by OO. It asked to add NutritionOrder to the NutritionProduct Boundaries and Relationships section and to modify NutritionIntake so it is described as the resource used for recording oral intake, supplements, enteral nutrition, and infant formula.
initial_application: Upstream commit f08af008345a71485a7eee5f3ce559a3c12559dd changed source/nutritionproduct/nutritionproduct-introduction.xml by adding the NutritionOrder list item and changing the NutritionIntake list item to start with 'Used for recording'. The combined branch already contained that source commit but had no Issue-Reconcile-Key trailer for FHIR-52017.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists nutritionproduct=NutritionProduct, confirming that the inspected introduction source is in current build scope. OO Nutrition minutes on 2025-08-27 said FHIR-52017 wording would be drafted using existing resource and module content for consistency, and the 2025-09-24 minutes record the 7-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote. Targeted Zulip and Jira searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Boundaries and Relationships list already includes NutritionOrder for requesting oral diets, oral nutrition supplements, enteral feedings, nutrition products, and infant formula, and it already identifies NutritionIntake as used for recording the relevant intake. The remaining wording differences from the Jira resolution are editorial rather than a different implementer-facing rule.

related_jiras.note: Mentioned in the same OO Nutrition minutes and application commit, but it concerns broader nutrition module revisions rather than the NutritionProduct boundary entry decided here.
